name: pems_driftinduced
_comment: Drift-induced sibling of pems.json, added 2026-08-30 per HarmonE.pdf §4.2-4.3: training stays on the unaltered flow_data_train.csv (train_path, identical to pems.json); ONLY stream_path differs, pointing at the drift-injected copy produced by managed_system_regression/utility/drift/induce.py (--dataset pems). weights_path entries are intentionally IDENTICAL to pems.json's so a model trained once (on the unaltered set, by whichever run executes first) is reused here rather than retrained — pems.json itself is left untouched and still points at the clean flow_data_test.csv, e.g. for experiments/calibrate_drift_threshold.py, which needs a genuinely undrifted val_split() to compute a meaningful null-distribution threshold. Run induce.py to generate flow_data_test_driftInduced.csv before using this config — nothing creates it automatically.
